newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan April ethylene output up 6.8 percent yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan April ethylene output up 6.8 percent yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's ethylene output in April totalled 599,000 tonnes, up 6.8 percent from a year earlier, but down five percent from March, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Tuesday.
The year-on-year increase was attributed to the fact that only one naphtha cracker was closed for routine maintenance this April, compared with three a year ago, a MITI official said.
As the naphtha cracker was shut in late March and remained closed until late April, production in April was lower than that in March, he added.
Ethylene, which is manufactured from naphtha, is the building block of various petrochemical products.
